description: This file defines the CanvasManager class responsible for managing canvas-related UI panels within a macOS application. It handles showing, hiding, and navigating to specific canvas sessions or URLs, manages auto-navigation based on gateway updates, and provides debug and status updates. It includes singleton access, session management, and external URL resolution.

classes.name: CanvasManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the display and interaction of canvas panels in a macOS application. It handles creating, reusing, and hiding canvas window controllers, auto-navigation based on gateway data, and updating debug/status information.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Prepares and displays a canvas session for a given sessionKey and optional path/placement, returning the directory path.

methods.name: showDetailed
methods.description: Displays or updates a canvas session with detailed parameters, returning a CanvasShowResult with information about the displayed canvas.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the canvas session associated with the given sessionKey if it is currently active.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code within the specified session's canvas and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the canvas session and saves it to the specified output path.

methods.name: startGatewayObserver
methods.description: Starts observing gateway updates for automatic navigation purposes.

methods.name: handleGatewayPush
methods.description: Processes incoming gateway push data, updating auto-navigation URLs as needed.

methods.name: maybeAutoNavigateToA2UIAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the A2UI URL and auto-navigates if conditions are met.

methods.name: maybeAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Performs auto-navigation to the A2UI URL if it has changed and auto-navigation is allowed.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the A2UI host URL from gateway data asynchronously.

methods.name: refreshDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status display based on current connection states.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl(from:)
methods.description: Constructs the A2UI URL by appending a specific path to the raw gateway URL if valid.

methods.name: directURL(for:)
methods.description: Converts a target string into a URL if it is an absolute URL or a valid file path.

methods.name: makeShowResult
methods.description: Creates a CanvasShowResult object based on the current session directory and target URL.

methods.name: localStatus
methods.description: Determines the current status of the local session given a directory and target path.

methods.name: indexExists
methods.description: Checks if index.html or index.htm exists within a specified directory.
